description: Warns when PME electrostatics are combined with a suspicious real-space Coulomb cutoff (below the recommended window) or a Coulomb/Van der Waals cutoff mismatch.

diagnostics.message: PME electrostatics with cutoff rcoulomb=0.6 nm is below the recommended ~1.0 nm window; disagrees with rvdw=1 nm; this skews the real/reciprocal split and degrades accuracy
